summary: Galaxy Gaming filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing a Second Amendment to its Credit Agreement with BMO Bank N.A. The amendment increases the annual capital expenditure limitation to no more than 10% of prior-year net revenue and approves a one-time $505,361 EBITDA addback solely for financial-ratio compliance. No securities, deal, or ownership change is involved; it is a routine credit-facility modification. Exhibit 10.1 contains the amendment. The risk-arb angle is nil, though the covenant relief signals tighter liquidity and warrants monitoring of future covenant headroom.
